```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Functions

```{r}
evaluation_timeline <- function(
  delivery_start,
  delivery_end,
  report_due,
  weeks_to_LA_start,
  weeks_referral_to_outcome,
  weeks_analysis_and_report
) {

  first_referral <- delivery_start + weeks(weeks_to_LA_start)

  last_outcome <- report_due - weeks(weeks_analysis_and_report)

  last_participant_referral <- last_outcome - weeks(weeks_referral_to_outcome)

  evaluation_weeks <- as.numeric(
    difftime(
      last_participant_referral,
      first_referral,
      units = "weeks"
    )
  )

  list(
    # Inputs
    delivery_start = delivery_start,
    delivery_end = delivery_end,
    report_due = report_due,
    weeks_to_LA_start = weeks_to_LA_start,
    weeks_referral_to_outcome = weeks_referral_to_outcome,
    weeks_analysis_and_report = weeks_analysis_and_report,

    # Outputs
    first_referral = first_referral,
    last_outcome = last_outcome,
    last_participant_referral = last_participant_referral,
    evaluation_weeks = evaluation_weeks
  )
}
```

```{r}
print_evaluation_timeline <- function(x) {

  fmt <- function(d) {
    format(as.Date(d), "%d %B %Y")
  }

  cat(
    paste(
      "EVALUATION TIMELINE",
      "",
      "Inputs",
      "------",
      sprintf("Delivery period starts:  %s", fmt(x$delivery_start)),
      sprintf("Delivery period ends:    %s", fmt(x$delivery_end)),
      sprintf("Report due:              %s", fmt(x$report_due)),
      sprintf("Weeks to first referral: %d", x$weeks_to_LA_start),
      sprintf("Referral to outcome lag: %d weeks", x$weeks_referral_to_outcome),
      sprintf("Analysis and reporting:  %d weeks", x$weeks_analysis_and_report),
      "",
      "Derived dates",
      "-------------",
      sprintf("First referral:            %s", fmt(x$first_referral)),
      sprintf("Last participant referral: %s", fmt(x$last_participant_referral)),
      sprintf("Last outcome measurement:  %s", fmt(x$last_outcome)),
      "",
      sprintf(
        "Effective evaluation window: %.1f weeks",
        x$evaluation_weeks
      ),
      sep = "\n"
    )
  )

  invisible(x)
}
```


```{r}
smooth_rise <- function(n, peak_at = 0.7, slope = 8) {
  k <- ceiling(peak_at * n)
  x <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = k)
  y <- plogis(slope * x)
  y <- (y - y[1]) / (y[k] - y[1])
  c(y, rep(1, n - k))
}
```


```{r}
smooth_rise_sample <- function(time_points, total_n, peak_at = 0.7, slope = 8) {
  y <- smooth_rise(n = time_points, peak_at = peak_at, slope = slope)
  y <- round(total_n * y / sum(y), 0)
}
```


## Calculate

```{r}
res <- evaluation_timeline(
  delivery_start = dmy("1/3/2027"),
  delivery_end   = dmy("1/3/2028"),
  report_due     = dmy("1/7/2028"),
  weeks_to_LA_start         = 0,
  weeks_referral_to_outcome = 6 * 4,
  weeks_analysis_and_report = 4 * 2
)

print_evaluation_timeline(res)
```




```{r}
eval_weeks <- floor(res$evaluation_weeks)
eval_weeks
```

```{r}
total_delivery_weeks <- difftime(res$delivery_end, res$delivery_start, units = "weeks") |>
  as.numeric() |>
  floor()
total_delivery_weeks
```

```{r}
total_delivery_n <- 1000
```




```{r}
weekly_delivery_n <- smooth_rise_sample(time_points = total_delivery_weeks,
                                      total_n = total_delivery_n,
                                      peak_at = 10 / 52,
                                      slope = 7)
data.frame(Week = 1:length(weekly_delivery_n),
           n = weekly_delivery_n) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(Week, n) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = eval_weeks, colour = "purple")
```

```{r}
sum(weekly_delivery_n)
```



```{r}
eval_sample <- head(weekly_delivery_n, eval_weeks) |> sum()
eval_sample
```
